baseline.query: what is the one precept you should never break
baseline.note: MN 61:36 — 'not ashamed to lie → no bad deed they would not do'

baseline.query: what were the Buddha's last words before he died
baseline.note: DN 16:1433 — 'Conditions fall apart. Persist with diligence.'

baseline.query: why does loving someone lead to grief and suffering
baseline.note: MN 87:66 — 'our loved ones are a source of sorrow'

baseline.query: should a monk feel anger even if attacked with a saw
baseline.note: MN 21:215 — even sawed limb from limb, show no malevolence

baseline.query: is having a good spiritual friend the whole of the holy life
baseline.note: SN 45.2 — 'half the spiritual life' → Buddha says it is the whole; SN 3.18 parallel

baseline.query: what is the path between self-indulgence and harsh self-denial
baseline.note: SN 56.11 — the middle way and the noble eightfold path

baseline.query: what is the deepest origin of all suffering
baseline.note: SN 56.11 — second noble truth: craving; SN 12.* — dependent origination

baseline.query: how should one breathe mindfully during sitting meditation
baseline.note: MN 118 — Ānāpānasati Sutta; SN 54 — Ānāpāna Saṃyutta

baseline.query: how does ignorance cause suffering step by step
baseline.note: SN 12.* — any Nidāna-saṃyutta sutta covers the dependent origination chain

baseline.query: how do you know whether a religious teaching is worth following
baseline.note: AN 3.65/66 — Kālāma Sutta and parallel: don't believe by tradition alone

baseline.query: what are the four foundations of mindfulness
baseline.note: MN 10 / DN 22 — Satipaṭṭhāna Suttas; SN 47 — Satipaṭṭhāna Saṃyutta

baseline.query: what are the components of the noble eightfold path
how should one treat parents family and friends according to the Buddha
baseline.note: DN 31 — Sigālovāda Sutta: duties to parents, spouse, friends, teachers

baseline.query: are the five aggregates permanent or do they lack a self
baseline.note: SN 22.59 — Anattalakkhaṇa Sutta: form, feeling, etc. are not self

baseline.query: what did the Buddha consider after enlightenment before deciding to teach
baseline.note: MN 26 — Ariyapariyesanā; SN 6.1 — Brahmā's request to teach

baseline.query: is there more than one version of the definition of suffering
baseline.note: MN 141 — Sāriputta's analysis drops 'association with unbeloved / separation from loved' vs Buddha's definition in SN 56.11 / DN 22
